evidence: Mountaineers and WTA reports describe a Methow-side Bulger scramble with only small snow patches by late June and no glacier; season starts July.
Rampart Ridge reports show the gully and ridge mostly snow in a July 2022 WTA report and snow-filled in June; no glacier on the Rachel Lake route. Changed to snow yes with a later date.
Mountaineers and SummitPost describe the southeast ridge as a rock route reached from Ingalls Creek and Porcupine Creek with no glacier on the line.
Searches found no description of this route, so neither glacier nor snow could be confirmed.
Cascade Climbers August report of the Church Lake and Bearpaw ridge mentions class 3 scrambling and no glacier or snow; Church Mountain has no glacier on this line; July date kept.
Mountaineers and Mountain Project note the Big Kangaroo descent gully is scree and snow and the west gullies hold snow into July; no glacier on the peak.
Same Big Kangaroo descent gully as the West Route: Mountaineers says snow-filled into July; changed from unsure to snow yes with an 08-01 date.
Mountaineers route notes say the west-side gullies are often snow-filled into July; no glacier.
Poster Peak trip reports (Mountaineers) found snow in the descent gully in July 2024 with an ice axe useful, so date moved later from 07-15; no glacier.
Search tied the name to the Dragontail and Colchuck Glacier side with Aasgard Pass snow into late July, so glacier travel could not be ruled out.
Mountaineers reports show moderately hard snow below the Bryant-Hemlock saddle in July and crampons planned in June; no glacier in the Snoqualmie area.
Buckhorn in the eastern Olympics has no glacier on the Marmot Pass route, but no report gave July snow timing.
Searches found no report for this peak; only similarly named peaks came up.
Mountaineers reports show Cannon's ridge melted out by late June with the final gully still snowy; a September ascent via the northwest ridge; no glacier.
No glacier on Cannon in the reports found, but none described the south slopes' snow timing.
WTA and Cascade Climbers reports show lingering snow near Cathedral lakes in June, little by July and none in August; the buttress is rock with no glacier described.
Mountaineers reports on the southwest face show a snow-free gully in June 2016 and July 2020 in some years, with advice to carry an axe; no glacier.
Mountaineers and a yellowleaf report describe the southeast slopes as scrambling with no glacier; no source gave snow melt timing.
Mountain Project describes the gully as snow in early season and one climber found it snow-filled throughout; date moved later; North Early Winter Spire has no glacier.
Stephabegg and Cascade Climbers describe the approach through a basin below the west face away from the glacier; no source gave snow timing.
Squire Creek Wall granite near Darrington has no glacier, with a September first ascent and a July repeat; snow timing at the saddle not found.
Sawtooth Ridge scramble with no glacier (Wikipedia, WTA); only an early November snow report found, no melt-out date.
A June 2017 Cascade Climbers report found snow on the approach gullies melting out; the route is a rock ridge with no glacier described.
